title: Duka la Herufi
author: Somo team (XPRIZE Kenya)
description: The shopkeeper asks for an item. Choose sh, ch or th to finish its name on the price tag, then read it. Level 2: at the end of the word. Level 3: read the whole word and find it.
description_sw: Mwenye duka anaomba kitu. Chagua sh, ch au th kumalizia jina lake kwenye lebo ya bei, kisha ulisome.

lines.en: Tap the green button to start.
Two letters, one sound. Say {w} slowly. Is it shh, ch or th?
lines.sw: Herufi mbili, sauti moja. Sema {w} polepole. Ni shh, ch au th?

lines.en: Welcome to my shop! Finish the name on the price tag with sh, ch or th.
lines.sw: Karibu dukani kwangu! Malizia jina kwenye lebo ya bei kwa sh, ch au th.

lines.en: Now the sound is at the END of the word.
lines.sw: Sasa sauti iko MWISHONI mwa neno.

lines.en: Now read the word on the tag and find the thing in the shop.
lines.sw: Sasa soma neno kwenye lebo na utafute kitu dukani.

lines.en: I need a {w}. Which sound finishes the tag?
Read the price tag. Which thing is it?
lines.sw: Soma lebo ya bei. Ni kitu gani?

lines.en: Look at the first two letters, or the last two. sh, ch or th?
lines.sw: Angalia herufi mbili za kwanza, au za mwisho. sh, ch au th?
